user.title: QuietCool Fan
user.description: Select a discovered QuietCool fan to set up.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Press the pairing button on your QuietCool fan, then click Submit to pair.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the fan. Make sure it is powered on and in range.

abort.no_devices_found: No QuietCool fans found nearby. Make sure the fan is powered on.
